title: WOS Studio (Authoring) — Common $defs Library
description: Shared $defs library for the Studio Stage-3 schema family. Carries the canonical enums that govern authoring discipline (OriginClass, MappingState, the per-entity lifecycle/review states) plus shared helpers (AuthorityGrantApplied, Iri). No document marker; this schema is registered by $id only and consumed by every other studio schema via $ref. The previously-exported StudioMetadataEnvelope was removed in Wave 1 of the Stage 3 + 4 review remediation (2026-05-02): the envelope is conceptual, not a structurally-inherited type — per-host inlining is the actual contract. See studio/CONCEPT-MODEL.md §6.1 (composition strategy) for the design.
$comment: Promotion status (Stage-3, 2026-05-01): MVP shapes; field lists are illustrative, not exhaustive. Inner fields may evolve as Stage-3 hardens; structural conformance to envelope/originClass/mappingState is load-bearing now.

OriginClass.description: Origin classification per authoring-provenance.md. Every approved PolicyObject + WorkflowIntent element MUST carry exactly one originClass: `source` (lifted directly from a SourceCitation), `approved-interpretation` (reviewer-judged interpretation of source), `local-practice` (workspace-specific operational practice with no upstream source), `assumption` (explicit gap-fill backed by an Assumption PolicyObject), or `runtime-observed` (proposed by a runtime-observation cluster — Phase-4 reserved seam).

MappingState.description: Mapping disposition per studio-to-wos-mapping.md. Precedence: mapsToWos > authoringOnly > requiresSpecExtension > unmappedButApproved. The four states encode the authoring-vocabulary-vs-substrate split (see CM §5 'WOS as canonical substrate').

AuthorityGrantApplied.description: Reference to an AuthorityGrant consulted during a permission decision. Records the grant id + the action it authorized.

grantRef.description: AuthorityGrant id from the workspace policy.

exercisedBy.description: Subject id (per identity-and-attestation.md) who exercised the authority.

Iri.description: Generic IRI (Internationalized Resource Identifier). Used for canonical term references, DPV terms, LegalRuleML terms, etc. Not enum-constrained — open vocabulary.

WaiverAttestationRef.description: Studio-profile projection of `rkaf:Attestation` whose `rkaf:targetFinding` points at the `rkaf:Finding` IRI being waived. Per ADR-0093 (Rulespec Finding IRI Addressability), every Studio waiver collapses to a single shape: an Attestation that overrides a Finding for a named scope. Replaces the four parallel pre-ADR-0093 waiver-flavor clumps (`parsingWaiverRef` on SourceVersion, `sensitivityWaiverRef` on ServiceBinding body, scenario-level `waiver`, and ValidationFinding flat `waivedBy`/`waivedRationale`/`waivedAt`/`waivedScope`). Field names mirror Rulespec `rkaf:Attestation` (stripped of the `rkaf:` prefix for JSON ergonomics): `targetFinding` (IRI of the rkaf:Finding being waived), `attestedBy` (IRI of the attestor — reviewer subject id), `attestationScope` (`this-instance-only` or `this-rule-on-this-subject-until-condition` or a free-form scope IRI), `attestedAt` (server timestamp), `rationale` (≥ 50 characters, substantive). `expirationCondition` carries an FEL expression for time-bounded waivers (required when `attestationScope = this-rule-on-this-subject-until-condition`).

targetFinding.description: IRI of the `rkaf:Finding` this Attestation overrides. Per ADR-0093 §Decision item 1: `Attestation(targetFinding=…)` is the unified waiver shape across Studio.

attestedBy.description: Subject id (per identity-and-attestation.md) of the reviewer attesting the waiver. Mirrors `rkaf:Attestation.attestor`.

attestationScope.description: Waiver scope. `this-instance-only` waives a single finding; `this-rule-on-this-subject-until-condition` waives the rule on the subject until `expirationCondition` evaluates true; free-form IRIs are allowed for site-specific scopes. Mirrors `rkaf:Attestation.attestationScope`.

attestedAt.description: Server timestamp the waiver Attestation was recorded. Mirrors `rkaf:Attestation.attestedAt`.

rationale.description: Substantive rationale (≥ 50 characters) explaining why the finding is waived. Mirrors `rkaf:Attestation.rationale`. Per SA-MUST-rv-030: a thin rationale is itself a finding.

expirationCondition.description: FEL expression evaluated to determine when a time-bounded waiver expires. Required when `attestationScope = this-rule-on-this-subject-until-condition`.

decision.description: Attestation decision; for waivers defaults to `rkaf:approvedWithConditions`. Mirrors `rkaf:Attestation.decision`.

allOf.$comment: SA-MUST-rv-030: time-bounded scope requires an expirationCondition.
